prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Spotlight Carousel Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a spotlight carousel layout with clear pet trait options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Companion Trait", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Summary Screen: Add a dedicated controls summary screen before home intro explaining system tray shortcuts and pet interactions.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_summary", "home_intro"], "new_controls_summary": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your system tray menu.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right click pet icon in taskbar for options", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Generation Notification Flow: Enable system notification alerts while pet generation completes so users can safely minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet", "body": "You can minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Stage Redesign: Redesign the opening story screen into a split stage format featuring pet preview animations.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_intro", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-in Recovery Warning Hint: Display a explicit notice on sign-in warning users to use their primary account to preserve adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Please sign in with your main account to safely sync and preserve your desktop pets."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Tip Carousel: Show a rotating carousel of desktop pet tips and shortcuts while pet generation is in progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 8, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Double click your pet anytime to trigger pet animations!", "style": "calm"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Guidelines Copy: Update photo upload headline and body text to specify ideal lighting and framing for custom pet generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Use well-lit, close-up photos of your pet for best 3D desktop pet rendering accuracy."}}
7: [finish, incentive] First Day Starter Gift Incentive: Add a welcome reward badge and starter pet treat unlock notice on the finish screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Home! Starter Treat Unlocked", "body": "Your new pet brought a special welcome gift. Complete setup to claim your starter item!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Gift Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a side-by-side two-column layout.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate"}}
9: [home, notification] System Tray Launch Notification Hint: Display a notification hint explaining that the app stays accessible in the taskbar tray if closed.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If the app window closes, your pet will remain active in your desktop system tray!"}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the pet selection screen layout within onboarding.
Adding a new controls summary screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Adding background completion notification copy to the waiting screen is permitted.
Valid redesign of the story screen split stage layout within onboarding.
Adding an account sign-in hint notice is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a tip carousel to the waiting screen is allowed.
Updating guidelines copy for photo upload is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions gifts ('starter gift', 'welcome gift'), violating Rule 3.
Redesigning adoption certificate layout to two-column format is allowed.
Adding system tray notification hint to waiting screen is allowed.
